A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''street vendor''' worked in the streets of a [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]] on [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. [[Mala Tinero|Mala]] knocked over and broke several of the [[Glass/Legends|glass]] sculptures he was selling.
